authority.extension: Explicit proposed implementation settings; lock and hash before new-source model fitting. Preserve previous protocols and results.

research_question: When do incomplete or imperfect recorded temporal references support a correct finite-pool model comparison, and what information is missing when they do not?

scope.primary_contract: A: no query during evaluation; operational END on recorded reference
scope.query_methods: disabled_in_v1; enable only under a separately specified archive/oracle/cost contract
scope.primary_estimand: mean paired binary Brier difference on one fixed scored pool
scope.later_assessment: separate descriptive loss/regret after selection; no guaranteed future ranking

sources.time_basis: preserve source recorded wall time; do not invent UTC
sources.member_selection: Only the 12 official PRSA station CSVs in PRSA2017_Data_20130301-20170228.zip; resolve nested ZIP; exclude unrelated data.csv/test.csv examples.
sources.hourly_transform: identity on the official hourly reference; duplicate station/time keys fail audit

sources.time_basis: preserve recorded wall time and document timezone uncertainty

hourly_transform.aggregation: mean RH_1 of exactly six distinct expected 10-minute slots with finite values
hourly_transform.incomplete_bin: unknown; no interpolation to manufacture reference

existing_sources.AgriFusion: application and provenance audit only in v1; Node1 historical canonical has 4681 rows; not a new physical reference
existing_sources.Stuard: historical source; not counted as either new candidate

threshold.fit_partition: full recorded train before train masking

time_grid_and_target.F: 1 if recorded canonical variable > train-only q75, else 0; genuinely unavailable variable remains unknown
time_grid_and_target.primary_reference_pool: all sufficiently long contiguous genuinely recorded finite-reference segments in each partition; no outcome-based thinning
time_grid_and_target.real_gap_policy: keep unknowns in audit; segment at a genuinely missing reference/grid discontinuity; do not treat a gap as observed F=0
time_grid_and_target.scoring: all remaining origins common to every candidate; do not shorten cohorts by method

splits.boundary_rule: floor cumulative unique-time counts; publish actual cutpoints and assignments before fitting
splits.purge: no raw dependency row ID shared across partitions; exclude first 24 recorded positions of every segment/partition from scored origins
splits.development_use: choose one static development-only default; no HPO in v1

hard: nonempty four partitions and eligible selection/assessment pools
both train END classes available to required supervised fits
source_support_gate.limited_support_flag: selection or assessment has fewer than 10 distinct positive END episodes; this is an operational flag, not a statistical sufficiency theorem
source_support_gate.action: retain audits and descriptive results; do not change q/K/splits to rescue a source; fail only incompatible stages and continue other sources

information_roles.forecaster: recorded, unmasked past values only; no current value, future value, END label or rule depth as input
information_roles.evaluator: fixed forecasts, observed possibly corrupted states, grid, program, declared budget, shared train rule and permitted development evidence
information_roles.audit_only: full reference, generated corruption locations, true loss/winner and later-assessment outcomes
information_roles.threshold_exception: q75 is a shared program parameter calibrated on recorded train only, not an estimator learned from masked reference
information_roles.assessment_policy: frozen model selected using selection partition only; report later outcomes after the choice

training.median_and_scale: fit on observed training values only
training.H6_features: 6 lagged values forward-filled using observed history, 6 past missing flags, one age feature; 13 columns; no current value
training.H24_features: 24 past values, 24 past missing flags, one age feature; 49 columns; same target and information policy
training.age: retain old cap 70 recorded steps for compatibility; no rule-run depth
training.COMPLETE_HGB: fit on END labels whose four defining operands are observed
training.SOFT_EM_HGB: same H6 features; fit expected binary log loss by duplicated 0/1 samples with weights 1-q and q from train-only Markov posterior
training.MARKOV: first-order binary transition/prior estimated from observed train; predict END causally before observing F_t
training.CONSTANT: prevalence among complete training END labels, recorded explicitly
training.HGB_COMPLETE_H24: same complete training labels and HGB parameters; longer predeclared causal history
training.empty_or_single_class: explicit failed_support/degenerate status; do not silently call a constant fallback a fitted HGB

development_default.reference: recorded development truth allowed for this predefined static baseline
development_default.choice: minimum development Brier; ties follow candidate order; freeze per source/train seed

evaluation_masks.coupling: same mask removes numeric predictor observations and reference states; scores are fixed once generated for a cell
evaluation_masks.block30: one uniformly placed contiguous missing block of ceil(0.30 * scored-length) per segment
evaluation_masks.seed_derivation: stable SHA256 of study/source/entity/partition/training-mask-seed/policy/mask-seed/role; publish the resulting integer seeds; do not use Python built-in hash

comparison.R0_scope: all 15 pairs, both selection and assessment; later-assessment verdicts are descriptive and cannot select the earlier model
mandatory_action_baselines: always choose each of six candidates
comparison.pool_certificate: one model certified better than every other candidate under the common feasible set, otherwise inconclusive
comparison.empty_subset: NA with n=0, never zero risk
comparison.regret: selection finite-pool regret and later-assessment regret separate, on the same scored cohort; decided-only loss must show its denominator

reference_error_sensitivity.scope: primary pair only in v1; all ordinary evaluation cells
reference_error_sensitivity.budget_unit: at most R wrong observed binary F states across the entire source+partition pool, across all its segments/sites
reference_error_sensitivity.prediction_policy: freeze original cell probabilities while varying R; include warmup observed states in the budget
reference_error_sensitivity.DP: rolling run-depth x exact-error frontier per segment; convolve one global budget; obtain all R in one max-R pass
reference_error_sensitivity.report: first tested budget losing a certificate; if grid has gaps report an interval, not an exact minimum; also R/n_observed
reference_error_sensitivity.sensors: R is a declared adversarial sensitivity assumption, not measured hardware error

synthetic_corruption_stress.scope: primary pair, training mask seed 11, mask seed 11, policies mcar30/block30, both periods and sources
synthetic_corruption_stress.construction: flip exactly C uniformly selected observed reference F states globally after masking; freeze forecaster scores; locations visible only to audit
synthetic_corruption_stress.inside_contract: R>=actual flipped observed state count; require true loss inside bounds
synthetic_corruption_stress.outside_contract: R<C; record out_of_contract, do not assert coverage guarantees
synthetic_corruption_stress.interpretation: synthetic archive-reference error only, not physical sensor calibration

generic_solver.scope: primary pair, selection only, training mask seed 11, mask seed 11, mcar30 and block30, both sources
generic_solver.objective_scaling: solve summed loss; normalize once on reporting
generic_solver.timeout: retain it; do not replace an optimum with an incumbent; a conservative dual bound may support a verdict if correctly transformed and numerically checked
generic_solver.comparison: match optimal values against DP within 1e-8 on normalized Brier; no timeout filtering or automatic stronger-solver retry

resources.cache: fit once per exact data/rule/split/train-mask/features/params/code/environment signature; reuse scores for evaluation methods and R
resources.smoke: toy oracle + earliest train/development segments only; one train seed and one MCAR30 mask; no tuning from smoke outcomes
resources.failure_policy: preserve partial outputs and fail the affected stage; do not suppress errors to mark complete

validation_gates: independent brute-force END enumeration versus DP for short traces at R=0 and R>0
two-segment global-budget check; no accidental R-per-segment implementation
full control R0 collapses bounds to exact paired loss
joint interval inside rectangle and separate-risk difference intervals, under their matching contracts
bounds nested as R increases; p-array checksum fixed
changing hidden values with the same mask leaves features unchanged
changing current/future values leaves an earlier forecast unchanged
no shared raw dependency IDs across partitions or entities
same scored keys for all compared methods; predictions finite and within [0,1]
truth only used in audit/reporting; simulated MNAR propensities not supplied to evaluators
solver witnesses recomputed independently; keep timeouts and failures
resume with changed signatures refuses cache reuse; immutable completed output directories

storage.record_level: partitioned Parquet/NPZ, with schema/array-key index and checksums; truth kept in an audit-only area
storage.code: snapshot or exact commit + dirty patch + checksum inventory; HEAD alone is insufficient
storage.status_compatibility: Keep execution completion separate from scientific support; limited support does not trigger endless execution retries.
storage.complete_marker: READY.json written last, only after required checks pass; failed/limited stages remain explicit
storage.drive_sync: upload readable summaries/indexes plus new immutable artifacts only; raw source stored once; verify upload metadata and write a delivery receipt; no automatic whole-project ZIP per run

stages.name: local implementation and evidence preservation
stages.gate: existing evidence untouched; new lane/help/config implemented

stages.name: source intake, reference, splits and support audit
correctness and legacy fixture checks
stages.gate: DP/oracle/causality/provenance tests pass; old fixture sensitivity 5,4,1,0 at R0..3

stages.name: small smoke on train/development only
stages.gate: all stages create valid, traceable outputs; no performance-based retuning

stages.name: main fixed-pool evaluation
stages.gate: all fixed controls, six models, R0 pairs and same-cohort results retained

stages.name: reference error sensitivity and specified corruption stress
stages.gate: conditional validity checks, nested bounds and fixed scores

stages.name: same-information generic solver comparison
stages.gate: all 16 planned solves accounted for if supported, including timeouts

stages.name: report, checkpoint and Drive handoff
stages.gate: human summary + structured tables + immutable artifact links + upload receipt

cli_contract.network: only audit --download may fetch official source releases; no Firebase calls
